steps.status: PASSED for SPY+IWM after universe rewrite

n_trials_note: One hypothesis test executed: single-bar DQ information coefficient against r_1, across 61 calendar blocks.
correction: The est_5min_drop column previously recorded in the pre-registration was derived from daily gap_rate assuming independent missing minutes. It materially UNDERSTATES the realised degenerate fraction because gaps cluster within sessions: SPY predicted 0.00% vs 3.87% actual, GLD 0.15% vs 5.82%, TLT 10.4% vs 15.2%. Screening on gap_rate is not a substitute for running prepare+validate.

kill_conditions_fired: K7 sign is the REVERSE of pre-registered H1

gate_evaluator_correction: G4 was implemented as abs(rho) >= 0.60 while spec section 6 writes the signed rho >= 0.60. On this run the implementation PASSED G4 at rho = -0.619 where the spec FAILS it. Fixed and re-evaluated; the verdict is unchanged because K2 and K7 both fired and any K firing is Verdict C. Disclosed because in another run it could have turned a FAIL into a PASS.
do_not_reinterpret: The observed IC is large, negative and highly consistent (58 of 61 blocks). That is a REJECTION of pre-registered H1, not a mean-reversion discovery. Spec 3.2 and kill condition K7 forbid re-interpreting a reversed sign as a finding. Testing a reversion hypothesis requires a NEW pre-registration and data not used here; the 252-session holdout remains sealed and untouched.
